title: How to Make a Faux Bronze Plaque
content: In this new video (link to YouTube), I show how to make a Steampunk-style fake bronze plaque out of epoxy clay, wood, springs, and wire. The result looks like an antique cast sign with raised letters, but this method is much faster and cheaper to make for the home craftsperson. The plaque is made with animated elements that rotate and lift up and down, operated by manual crank levers that turn a camshaft.Materials:Magic Sculpt Clay1/4 inch birch plywoodSet of springsThin plywood plaquesBronze spray enamelRelated Gumroad Video:How to Make a Sketch Easel
